featured_reviews.name: Beingkeralite
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our team had a wonderful shopping experience at Platinum Sports in Tilak Nagar while preparing for our upcoming cricket match. As soon as we entered the shop, we were greeted by friendly and helpful staff who guided us patiently through the wide range of sports equipment. The store had everything we needed—from high-quality bats, balls, gloves, pads, helmets, and jerseys to shoes and accessories.

The staff helped us choose the right equipment according to our age and playing level, and they even gave us useful tips on maintaining our gear. The prices were reasonable, and the quality of products was excellent. The billing process was quick and smooth, which saved us a lot of time.

Overall, our visit to Platinum Sports was enjoyable and stress-free. We left the shop feeling confident and excited for our match. It was truly a great team shopping experience, and we would definitely recommend Platinum Sports in Tilak Nagar to all sports lovers.

featured_reviews.name: Anil k
featured_reviews.review_text:
Platinum Sports offers an overall average experience—neither exceptional nor disappointing. The brand delivers decent quality across its range of products, from fitness apparel to sports accessories, but it doesn’t particularly stand out in any category. The materials used are durable and comfortable for everyday use, though they may not match the premium feel or advanced technology found in top-tier sports brands. Pricing is reasonable and provides fair value for money, making it a suitable choice for casual users and beginners rather than professional athletes.

Customer service is adequate, with satisfactory response times, but post-sale support could be improved. The brand’s online presence and packaging are professional, though product availability sometimes varies across regions. In terms of performance, items like shoes and training gear serve well for regular workouts or light sports activity but might lack the advanced support required for intense performance.

Overall, Platinum Sports can be described as a “safe middle ground”—a brand that meets basic expectations without major flaws but also without the innovation or premium edge that might attract demanding athletes. It’s reliable for daily fitness needs, but there’s room for improvement in design, technology, and customer engagement to reach a higher standard.

featured_reviews.name: Laxman Katta
featured_reviews.review_text:
ONE OF THE WORST AND MOST FORGING PRODUCTION HOUSE WITH OVERHYPED ADVOCATE!!

We had to print T-Shirts for our company with our LOGO and TAGLINE on front to back. We approached the garment house for the selection, We have been introduced to the samples with two categories of price tags that one is HIGH range and the other is LOW range by the owner himself.

The guy is robust with gun-point salesmanship, convinced us of HIGH price range carries great quality and most of their brand ambassadors in tennis cricket field wears. Without giving it a thought, We have place the order of 30+ quantities at the HIGH range and we were promised to get a call when the order is ready - and we did not get the call for a week and when we call the guy and the guy scold us back squalling us of being irresponsible for not calling him on order.

When we reach there to collect the product/lot, We got astonished to witness that our products were of very very poor quality that carries very much of dull print. There was pretty much deflection in the color and when we bring that into their notice, the guy refuse to take responsibility and inducing indisposed pretexts by saying "Yeh Aise Hi Hota Hain, 420 Rs Per Piece Mein Aur Kya Chahiye?".

This guy left us with no choice than to take up and get the hell out from there.

Final part: The payment was around Rs 12000/- and we were determined to pay using UPI or Card Swipe. and the guy is not ready to accept any of those. This is 2022, and who accepts CASH of Rs 12000? unless there is any tax evasion.

NOTE: The quality they provide to their ambassador and the quality they provide to the normal people like us very different. irrespective of the quality and quantity, the guy has always been rude to customers and there are many people claiming the same against this guy.

DO NOT BUY FROM SUCH PEOPLE AND IF YOU DO, IT WILL GIVE THEM SUPERBIA TO HUMILIATE THE ORDINARY PEOPLE LIKE US.
